      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30m "Cardio - Moderate Intensity":
        main:
          cycling 30m rpe 6
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Plyometric / Power":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          box_jump 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          jump_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 4x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 4m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday cardio 20m "HIIT - Rowing Intervals":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main:
          rowing 10x30s rpe 9 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

    notes "Aim for a slight caloric surplus to support muscle growth. Adjust based on weight trends (target 0.25-0.5kg gain per week)."

    target "1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight per day"
    notes "Distribute protein evenly across 3-5 meals. Prioritize lean sources (chicken, fish, eggs, dairy, tofu, legumes)."

    target "3-6g per kg bodyweight per day"
    notes "Emphasize whole grains, fruits, and vegetables. Increase intake around training sessions."

    target "0.8-1.2g per kg bodyweight per day"
    notes "Include healthy fats (olive oil, nuts, seeds, avocado, fatty fish)."
